common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Safety Breakthrough
common.line: An interpretability or control result measurably improves assurance on systems already deployed, rather than on toy models – behaviour that can be predicted before it is observed, or a property that can be certified rather than argued for.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Gigafactory siting backlash
notable.line: Coordinated protests against proposed gigafactory sites over power prices and water use escalate into permit blockades and brief occupations in two bidding regions, delaying site decisions.

notable.title: Grid forensics leak
notable.line: Independent press investigation publishes leaked forensic details from the grid intrusions, naming vendors and unpatched remote-access tools and triggering compensation claims against two European operators.

notable.title: Grid insurance crunch
notable.line: European industrial insurers sharply reprice operational-technology cyber cover after the autumn grid intrusions, demanding certified segmentation audits that most municipal utilities cannot yet pass, freezing some Shield procurement.
